title: Згода та її історія
roles: R01 для збору; R02/фахівець із прав за доступом
fields_and_relations: Особа, сеанс, обсяг/мета/use, докази, effective_at та revision history.
required_interaction: Часткове відкликання → нова версія й залежні перегляди; доказ лишається приватним.

implementation.view_model: Private consent list, evidence wizard, scopes, partial/complete withdrawal and dependent-policy/publication invalidation; document/audio/video evidence with exact source revisions, interval playback, explicit confirmation and original-file privacy Consent proof: scan, handwritten phone signature with frozen terms, exact audio/video annotations, protected fragment links and download of scanned PDF.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; existing user state is preserved, new grants require explicit human review.
permissions: Scoped text.read/write/review, consent.read/write, processing.run and deposit.manage are independent
Consent evidence is not exposed by text/public/deposit views
Processing and deposit require separate current use decisions
implementation.atomicity: Command validates scope, expected version, exact relationships and immutable hashes before one commit; forms hold drafts until confirmation
limitations: Local browser storage: up to 2 MiB per proof, 30-second device capture; no server upload/resume or protected proof transport.
Old evidence descriptions remain supported. Media proof does not automatically grant operational access.
Separate replacement consent acts and broad multi-person policy authoring remain additional work.
implementation.research_scope: Explicit public/research purpose for view/citation consent; proof remains private. Recording a consent does not grant operational access.
